pair.noDimmersFound: No dimmers found. The app supports LEDDim Smart of every generation, but not SG Smart 3.0. Close the SG Smart app on your phone and try again closer to a dimmer. If that does not help, send a diagnostics report right away: Settings, Apps, SG LEDDim.

members.title: Dimmers in this group
members.hint: Select the dimmers to control. They must already be added to Homey.
members.none: No dimmers added. Add dimmers before creating a group.

csr.failed: Search failed. Try again in a moment.

found.noDimmerButPill: No rotary dimmers found, but found __products__. Go back and select "LEDDim Smart Pill" to add them.
found.noPillButDimmer: No Pill found, but found __products__. Go back and select "LEDDim Smart" to add them.
found.notYet: Found __products__, which cannot be added yet.

guide.title: Before you search
guide.closeApp: Close the SG app on phones and tablets.
guide.near: Keep Homey close to a dimmer or device.
guide.password: The password is 1234 unless you changed it in the SG app.
guide.durationPill: The search usually takes less than a minute.

keepConnected.label: Keep dimmers connected
keepConnected.hint: Faster control, and changes made at the wall switch appear immediately. Only works with first-generation LEDDim Smart (@NDxxxx). If you only have one such dimmer, the SG Smart app on your phone cannot reach it while this setting is on.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Shown under Status when you open a first-generation dimmer. "Direct" means the dimmer is connected to Homey. Other dimmers are reached through it. Weak signal? Move Homey closer to a dimmer.

otherDevice.title: Which SG devices are supported
otherDevice.rotary: First generation (@NDxxxx) is stable. Later generations, including TW, Master and 400 2-pole, are being tested.
otherDevice.pill: , including Micro, TW and Smart Pill ON-OFF: being tested.
otherDevice.sg3: , the products with 3.0 in the name, is not supported yet.
otherDevice.other: Other SG devices, such as DIN, Push, Floor and Pill DALI, are not supported yet.
otherDevice.report: Something not working? Report it in the forum thread.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.hint: Only enable when the developer asks. Turn it off before sending a diagnostics report.

log.hint: Shows the latest log lines. Bluetooth addresses and device names are hidden, but the log shows when lights are used. Send it as a private message to the developer in the forum, not in the thread.
log.copyManual: Text selected. Copy with Ctrl+C, or press and hold the text.
log.empty: The log is empty. Use the lights a little, and try again.
log.failed: Could not get the log. Try again in a moment.

device.notHeard: No contact with the dimmer. Wrong password or out of range?
device.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the dimmer's first status.
device.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password. Check settings.

notification.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password in SG LEDDim. Check Network Isolation in the SG app, or enter the correct password in the settings for each dimmer.
